concept.title: Add a custom call-to-action to your LinkedIn Page

metadata.helpCenter: Recruiter HC, LinkedIn HC, Marketing Solutions HC

note.p: We're gradually making this feature available, and you might not have access to it at this time. You must be a super admin of the Page to subscribe to Premium Company Page.

conbody.p: A custom call-to-action button can be used to boost engagement with your LinkedIn Page. If you're a Page admin, you can choose different names for the call-to-action and customize it with a unique URL. When you create a custom call-to-action, the button will appear at the top of your Page. Any URL can be used for the call-to-action button you choose.

note.p: You can add Request services as a call-to-action button if you offer services on your Company Page. Learn more about offering services on LinkedIn on your Company Page. You can add Request demo as a call-to-action button only if you have a published Flagship product page. Learn more about Flagship product pages.
